scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,UI -c blue,green "bun run dev:server" "bun run dev:ui"
scripts.generate:embeds: bun run generate:ui-manifest && bun run generate:migrations-manifest
scripts.build: bun run build:ui && bun run generate:embeds
scripts.compile: bun build --compile --minify --windows-hide-console --target=bun-windows-x64 src/bootstrap/main.ts --outfile dist/Argus.exe && bun run scripts/patchPeSubsystem.ts dist/Argus.exe
scripts.compile:launcher: bun build --compile --minify --windows-hide-console --target=bun-windows-x64 src/bootstrap/launcher.ts --outfile dist/Argus-Launcher.exe && bun run scripts/patchPeSubsystem.ts dist/Argus-Launcher.exe
